description: This file contains C source code for fsmonitor settings on Darwin (macOS). It includes functions to check the compatibility of Unix domain sockets based on the filesystem type and remote status, which are used for inter-process communication (IPC) in the filesystem monitor.

methods.name: enum:fsmonitor_reason check_uds_volume(struct repository * r)
methods.description: Checks the filesystem type of the volume hosting the IPC socket to determine compatibility based on filesystem type and remote status.

methods.name: enum:fsmonitor_reason fsm_os__incompatible(struct repository * r,int ipc)
methods.description: Determines overall compatibility of the environment for IPC socket based on remote status and filesystem type.
